notes: New speech model: Parakeet Ultra. Fewer misheard English words at the same speed. If you already use the English model, it keeps working while the new one downloads in the background (about 489 MB), and Koegaki switches over once it is ready. The English model now downloads from Koegaki's own model mirror. No recordings or transcripts are ever sent. If Koegaki finds a damaged English model file, it repairs or replaces it instead of loading it.
